title: Sapo Workflow Blueprint (DSL Grammar v1)
description: Editor tooling and external producers only. The authority on what the engine accepts is sapo::parser::WorkflowParser plus sapo::parser::BlueprintValidator (src/parser/), which additionally checks node ids, jump targets, reachability, cycles, capability registration and unused fields. Anything this file allows but the parser rejects is a bug in this file.

name.description: Workflow id used by subflow/`workflow` references and the registry. Default: sapo.workflow

nodes.description: Execution is jump-based: the entry point is the first node, and a node without `next` ends the session unless it is inside a body (loop/then/catch/branch), where the next sibling follows implicitly.

trigger.description: Starts the workflow from the event bus instead of an explicit call.

event.description: Exact name or prefix pattern, e.g. payments.*

input.description: Merged into the session context at start

defaults.description: Seed values merged into every session context

template.description: Interpolation template: `${<SEL expression>}` blocks mixed with literal text; a lone `$path` yields the value with its JSON type. Value fields (assign, output, input, collection, count, message, selector) use this form.

predicate.description: SEL program evaluated to a boolean (condition, when, while, until, filter, predicate, input_validation, trigger_condition, execute_condition). Do NOT wrap it in `${}`: that yields truthiness of the interpolated text, not a comparison.

retry_on.description: Error codes or HTTP statuses that are retryable. Empty means transport errors and 5xx/429 only; a non-empty list replaces the default.

output.description: Context key the reply is written to

options.description: Dynamic menu options. `source` resolves to an array; `labelFormat` and `valueFormat` support `$Property` placeholders (for example `$BankChannel - $BankCode` and `$BankCode`) and determine the displayed label and stored value. Supports raw scalar arrays and pagination via `page_size`, `page_variable`, `next_value`, `previous_value`, `back_value`, and `back_next` (the node id to jump to when the back value is selected).

features.description: Alias for dynamic menu options; may contain the options directly or under an `options` object.

timeout.description: Milliseconds, or a duration string such as 90s / 2m

id.description: Unique across the whole blueprint, hoisted children included. Synthesised when omitted.

next.description: Node id. A body node whose `next` leaves its body escapes that body.

on_error.description: Node id run when this node fails; $error carries {code, message, node, data}

capability.description: action: dot-notation capability, must resolve to a registered provider; empty when the node only prompts or awaits an event

input.description: action/command: inputs sent to the capability, template-valued

output.description: command/action: object of context key -> result path ($.body.name), or a single context-key string

handler.description: Node id to resume at; the node itself is re-entered by default

next_tasks.description: action: first matching entry wins; used to build menu-style routing

command.description: command: e.g. http.get, http.post, http.put, http.patch, http.delete, http.request

iterator.description: loop: name bound to the current item (default: item)

index.description: loop: name bound to the current position (default: index)

duration.description: wait: 30s, 5m, 1200ms, 45 (bare = seconds), or an ISO-8601 deadline

until.description: wait: predicate re-checked each poll, or an absolute timestamp

workflow.description: schedule: workflow to start (self-recursion is rejected)

source.description: query: data-source name; an undeclared id reads the context collection of that name

filter.description: query: object/array row matcher, or a SEL predicate string

mapping.description: transform: per-row projection or grouping key

code.description: script: one SEL program; see docs/LIMITATIONS.md for the Lua gap

bindings.description: script: locals evaluated as programs before the body

child_tasks.description: parallel: branches, each an id array or an inline node array

return.description: subflow: map child output keys onto parent keys

catch.description: try: handler body, or an object with as/when/body

as.description: context variable the error object is bound to (default: error)

status.description: terminate: maps to SessionStatus completed / failed
